P1: 35号道路 is a short, pleasant path that leads northward from 满金市. The main road leads to a gate that serves as the entrance to both the 自然公园 and the Pokéathlon Dome, while a smaller trail acts as a shortcut to 36号道路.
D1: Held by Kenya, a 烈雀 received from the guard in the southern gate
D2: West of the tall grass, in a corner of the grove of trees
D3: In the clearing in the southeast corner
D5: From the guard in the southern gate, after delivering his Spearow with its Mail to 31号道路
D6: Northwest of the pond, on a tree (daily; requires 冲浪)
D7: North of the Apricorn tree; west-northwest of Juggler Irwin (hidden; requires 冲浪)
P2: Speak to the guard in the southern gate, and he asks for a favor. Deliver his 烈雀, named Kenya, and the piece of Mail it holds to his friend on 31号道路. It is intended for the man dozing near the pond there. Complete the delivery, and he wakes up just long enough to give you 招式学习器44（睡觉）. Return here and speak to the guard afterward to receive an ＨＰ增强剂 as a reward.
P3: Enter the north gate and go left. If you speak to the first man, he introduces himself as Cameron the Photographer. He asks if you would like to have your photo taken, and if so, proceeds to take a snapshot of you alongside your party Pokémon.
P4: The Pokéathlon Dome is a venue where Pokéathlon competitions are held. Only the most athletic Pokémon will win the gold!

D9: South of the Aprijuice stand, in the southernmost field of grass (hidden)

* Interior; from a blond man on the east side, after tackling 2,000 times in the Pokéathlon
P5: After exiting the gate, move north along the path to be met by an old man and his 蚊香泳士. He believes that your lead Pokémon is ready to participate in the Pokéathlon, and leads the way to the Pokéathlon Dome building. He invites you to take part in the athletic competitions held here, and introduces himself as Magnus, the venue's founder, before heading inside.
P6: In the plaza to the west, there is a stand that offers Aprijuice for sale. Seeing a confused look on your face, the attendant gives you an Apriblender so that you may familiarize yourself with the beverage. This device is stored in the 球果盒 and is used to blend Apricorns into Aprijuice, a type of drink that improves a Pokémon's athletic performance. Up to five Apricorns may be added to the Apriblender at once, after which the user must walk 100 steps in order to mix up the drink. Each cycle produces enough Aprijuice for three servings. Attributes including flavor level, mildness level, and taste all influence the drink's effect on a Pokémon. These effects are temporary, and wear off when the Pokémon is stored in the PC.
P7: The stand's selection of Aprijuice includes three of five varieties, each having been developed by a popular Pokéathlete. Availability varies by the day.
P8: When you reach the front desk, you are approached by Whitney, who is also here to participate in the Pokéathlon. She is excited to enter the competition but is surprised at your outfit, and runs off for a moment before returning with a Jersey so that you may look your best. She suddenly remembers that she left her Pokémon behind, and leaves for 满金市 to retrieve them.
P9: There are five courses to enter, with each prioritizing a single performance stat. Each course includes three events.
C5: Hurdle Dash, Pennant Capture, and Relay Run
C7: Block Smash, Circle Push, and Goal Roll
C9: Snow Throw, Goal Roll, and Pennant Capture
C11: Ring Drop, Relay Run, and Block Smash
C13: Lamp Jump, Disc Catch, and Hurdle Dash
P10: By winning courses, the participating Pokémon will earn medals for their species. Trainers earn points based on how well their team did and if they qualified for any bonuses. The Trainer with the highest score wins, with a tie settled with a random draw by the Pokéathlon host. A win will earn the Trainer an additional 100 points, which can be spent on prizes at the Athlete Shop, or Data Cards that may be used to see records of various actions, course wins and losses, and other statistics. Beating the records for all 10 of the events in the Pokéathlon increases the Trainer Card level.
P11: The 自然公园 is a beautiful recreational space between 35号道路 to the south and 36号道路 to the east. A haven for 虫 and 草 Pokémon, a Bug-Catching Contest is held here every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday.

P12: There is no entry fee for the Bug-Catching Contest. Anyone may enter once per day, every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday.
P13: To compete, Trainers must catch the single best 虫 Pokémon they can find. To do this, Trainers are given 20 竞赛球s and are only allowed to use a single Pokémon from their party. The others remain with the contest officials until the competition is over. Any Pokémon caught will be recorded in the Pokédex, but only one Pokémon may be kept to be judged. The Pokémon selected to be judged may be kept after the competition.
P14: The competition ends when 20 minutes have passed, all 竞赛球s have been used, or the Trainer blacks out, leaves the park, or chooses to quit. After that, the judging will occur, in which Trainers are scored on their skills of capturing rare and powerful Pokémon.

P15: 36号道路 is a densely wooded path that branches off in several directions. It connects the 自然公园 and 35号道路 in the west with the 阿露福遗迹 to the south, 桔梗市 to the east, and 37号道路 to the north.

P16: The odd tree mentioned by the woman in 满金市's flower shop can be found in the middle of the route, blocking travel from every direction. Despite its tree-like appearance, this oddity actually tries to avoid water. The woman's sister, Floria, is here to investigate, and urges you to sprinkle it with the SquirtBottle. Splash a bit of water on it, and it attacks! It turns out to be a 树才怪, a rare Pokémon that is more similar to a rock than a tree.
P17: Afterward, Floria gives you the 树果种植盆 as thanks for entertaining her. This portable planter allows a Trainer to plant, water, and grow Berry plants while traveling. She also gives out three Oran Berries and three Pecha Berries so that you may try it out. Hearing that your next destination is 圆朱市, she directs you northward before leaving to return to 满金市.
P18: Once the path is clear, speak with the man to the east to receive 秘传学习器06（碎岩）.
P19: 37号道路 is a short road that leads north from 36号道路 to 圆朱市. A secluded grove of Apricorn trees stands on the east side.
